Model credits

Tesla Roadster 2020 by metarex.4d is used under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International.

Adapted for Roadster Run: reduced geometry, resized and compressed textures, adjusted materials, animated wheels, and added fictional thrusters. The original creator does not endorse this game.

Rendering uses Three.js and model decompression uses meshoptimizer, both under the MIT license.

Roadster Run is an independent fan-made game. It is not affiliated with Tesla or SpaceX.
